Daily Devotional

September 25

13 Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;14 Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well. (1 Peter 2:13-14 KJV)

The Bible does not teach us to rebel against our rulers or government. We are to be a good example to all the unbelievers, and one way that we do that is to obey all the laws of the land, as God has ordained government for our protection, and punishment of evildoers. This is written by Peter, who when commanded by the rulers to quit preaching Jesus, refused to quit (Acts 5:28-29). Even though Peter did not obey the ungodly command of the rulers, he did submit to their authority, and did not rebel against them. We are not to ever obey a command that goes against what God has told us to do, but we are not to rebel at the authority placed over us.

How we live our lives, and how well we obey the laws and rules given us by the government, is a testimony as to our Christian faith. Remember that the unsaved in the world are watching all Christians to see how they live their lives, and to many it is the only godly thing they will ever see, as many don’t go to church or read the Bible. Live your life as Jesus would have you to, and you will reach others by example. Let your light shine out into this dark world (Matthew 5:16).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
